metadata.source: PSOC - Scheduled Task creation during Non Business Hours.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Scheduled Task creation during Non Business Hours
properties.description: scheduled tasks on servers are usually not created out of hours, this could be the work of an attacker.
properties.query:
let server_names = 
DeviceInfo 
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) 
| where DeviceType == 'Server'
| distinct DeviceName;
let process_names = dynamic(["schtasks.exe"]);
let cmd_all = dynamic(["/create"]);
_Im_ProcessCreate(targetprocess_has_any=process_names,commandline_has_all=cmd_all)
| where datetime_part("hour", TimeGenerated) !between (7 .. 19)
| where Dvc in (server_names)
| extend
    Account = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUsername", "")),
    AccountDomain = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUserDomain", "")),
    Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("DvcHostname", "")),
    ProcessName = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessName", "")),
    ProcessId = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessId", "")),
    CommandLine = tostring(column_ifexists("CommandLine", ""))
| where isnotempty(ProcessName)
